assessor: RTS implementation preflight — Adversarial Human Review Necessity Triage v1
rationale: Repository-local postprocessing of an already-valid J refinement report only. K0 does not fetch network data, call a provider/model, create semantic truth, alter H/F/G runtime behavior, or drop evidence. It assigns advisory human-attention classes while preserving exact unresolved anchors and two separate adversarial assessments.
affected_boundaries: DA and Counter-DA advisory assessment records
impact / causal reach / perspective gap scoring
focused destructive DA and full A-K regression
existing_assumptions: J reports retain exact unresolved anchor previews/hashes/source IDs and an input fingerprint.
Unresolved official-doc text remains semantically unverified.

data_migration.notes: No existing intake/refinement/transition/profile/FREEZER history is mutated in place.

approval_changes: none; triage grants no execution/profile-application/promotion authority
DEFER_LOW_VALUE is attention scheduling only, never semantic dismissal or evidence deletion
hidden_dependencies: every unresolved J finding must appear exactly once in triage output
DA and Counter-DA cases remain separate
perspective gap must not be averaged away
high causal reach can override low immediate impact
explicit contract-change signals override generic noise heuristics
causal reach is an advisory score/path, not a measured probability
rollback_boundary: Drop the K0 branch or revert review_necessity_triage files and FRZ-000021 append-only versions; A-J remain untouched.
completion_conditions: each unresolved J item yields one triage record with separate DA and Counter-DA cases
impact and causal reach are scored separately
perspective gap increases review priority when lenses disagree materially
low immediate impact plus high causal reach can produce HUMAN_NOW
marketing/noise wording cannot suppress explicit execution-contract signals
low-value items can become DEFER_LOW_VALUE without being dropped
truncated/stale input produces REVIEW_BLOCKED or fails closed
live I→J→K0 triage reports useful differentiation across the current residual surface
A-K regressions and FREEZER verify pass
risks: v1 deterministic lenses are advisory heuristics and not a semantic correctness oracle
future model-assisted DA/Counter-DA proposals must remain behind deterministic validation
human-review count reduction is not itself correctness evidence
